notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon (Little Lamps shelf). Piece: vincent-and-the-babies-at-the-church-door, story body 1,451 words, text only: audio dirs at 423 MB, over the 400 MB cap. Sources reached this session: newadvent.org (1912 Catholic Encyclopedia), famvin.org VincentWiki (quotes Vincent's own account of Châtillon and dates it Sunday 20 August 1617; checked with Python as a Sunday), and en/fr Wikipedia raw text on Vincent, Louise de Marillac, Marguerite Naseau and the Daughters of Charity. Two points were softened after rereading the sources: the Tunis doubt, because historians disagree rather than mostly reject it, and the foundling house, staffed by sisters and four nurses rather than wet-nurses.
